items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Is Seth playing a piano then? Oh, yeah. ... I know he played violin just like, so he's a wonderful guy. And I don't know, I really think a lot of him, you know?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Until they closed. That's why I like Pastor Dave, because he's the one that, uh, you know, he appreciated me. Yes. You know? He's a wonderful man. Yeah, you see, being in a place like that, I know, uh, we was there just for the money, you know? Sure. But, uh, I know he'd rather have his name, uh, you know, somewhere else than to be in the district, you see? Yeah, sure. He says, see, we was there for money, well, and being with a fellow like him, I was glad to know that someday I would be able to mention…
Do you remember some of the other piano players around the district?
